content: Replace the spreadsheet quoting process with Sales Cloud quoting; success spine: quote turnaround from 9 days to 2.
A June assessment settled the CRM platform decision; pricing model design was left deliberately open.
Quotes are built in a 14-tab spreadsheet owned by one analyst; the approval step is a manual email chain.
ERP (keep, owner: client IT director), legacy CRM (replace), tax engine (connect).
Sales Cloud owns quoting; ERP keeps order fulfillment; one nightly sync crosses the seam.
Two-phase rollout chosen over big bang (settled, Pursuit Lead, 2026-07-08). Maturity-gap flag carried: ERP integration.
AE told the sponsor a report pack would be included; not in the SOW. Flagged, owner: Pursuit Lead.
Assumption: under 50,000 records migrate from a clean source; if false, the migration estimate reopens.
Economic buyer (CFO) was in the deal cycle but is not on the delivery roster: flagged mismatch.
The 2025 distributor build's approval-matrix template applies; lives in the prior-engagement Drive folder.
